definitions.explanation: A character written or typed incorrectly. Unlike English typos, which involve wrong letters, Japanese 誤字 typically involves writing the wrong kanji, using an incorrect homophone, or mixing up similar-looking characters. Composed of 誤 (mistake) + 字 (character).

examples.japanese: {誤字|ごじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誤字|ごじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This document has a lot of typos.

examples.japanese: ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誤字|ごじ}⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check for typos and omitted characters before submitting.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly paired with ⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧ (omitted characters) in the set phrase {誤字|ごじ}⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧, often abbreviated to {誤字|ごじ}{脱|だつ}. This combination covers both wrong characters and missing characters, similar to English "typos and omissions."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤字|ごじ}⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧ (typos and omitted characters)
- {誤字|ごじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to fix a typo)
- {誤字|ごじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧ (to find a typo)
- {誤字|ごじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ (typos are noticeable)
